CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(SLA_Start_1__c),0,BLANKVALUE(BLANKVALUE(SLA_Stop_1__c,TODAY())-SLA_Start_1__c,-1)+1) - IF(ISBLANK(SLA_Start_1__c),0,1) /* Subtract 1 day once item received to align timer with QAD (Received day counts as day 0)*/ + IF(ISBLANK(SLA_Start_2__c),0,BLANKVALUE(BLANKVALUE(SLA_Stop_2__c,TODAY())-SLA_Start_2__c,-1)+1) - IF(ISBLANK(SLA_Start_2__c),0,1) /* Subtract 1 day once PO approved to align timer with QAD (PO approved day doesnt count)*/ - IF(SLA_Stop_1__c=SLA_Start_2__c,1,0) - IF(ISBLANK(SLA_Paused__c),0,TODAY()-SLA_Paused__c) - SLA_Days_Paused__c - SLA_Weekends_Holidays__c
CustomField.label: SLA Total
